placement: Capability Pack — src/capabilities/lifecycle/ with its own contract unit. Online/offline, visibility, pagehide/pageshow (with bfcache persisted), freeze/resume, prerendering and advisory connection quality are browser facts; the pack reports them on request and by subscription, typed with what each can and cannot prove (navigator.onLine is not backend reachability). The kernel never pauses or resumes anything: the engine decides. Core unchanged; absent unless registered. The smoke runner gains network-emulation, web-lifecycle and back/forward actions.
